ev.q: Among 1,216 Nebraska-resident meat processing facility workers tested, 375 (31%) had positive results.
Limitations of this analysis include the absence of a comparison group
Approximately one third (78; 32%) of respondents reported no symptoms.
Nearly three quarters of workers (73%) reported having a flexible medical leave policy
Among the 241 interviewed workers, 57% were male, the median age was 41 years
This investigation was determined by CDC to be public health surveillance.

methods_quotes.q: Close contact was defined as being within 6 feet (2 m) for ≥10 minutes in the 2 weeks preceding symptom onset or testing.
Workers were queried about exposures during the 14 days before symptom onset
only persons who participated in testing, had positive test results, had contact information, answered the telephone, and agreed to be interviewed were included.
